neighbours.label: the slot in a review just before declaring something one's favourite or go-to (became my, is now our, their favorite)
fire: I got this kettle as a gift and it soon became my favourite appliance.
After one week this app is now our go-to for planning meals.
Honestly these headphones have become my everyday essential.
My kids say this is their favorite book of the whole year.
We tried a dozen brands and this one is now our number one.
The little cafe on the corner quickly became my regular spot.
This sunscreen has become my holy grail for summer.
Since the move this blanket has become our most loved possession.
quiet: I got this kettle as a gift and it came in a cardboard box.
After one week this app sent us a reminder to update.
Honestly these headphones arrived with a short charging cable.
My kids say this book has a lot of pictures in it.
We tried a dozen brands and this one was the cheapest.
The little cafe on the corner opens at seven every morning.
This sunscreen comes in a white bottle with a blue cap.
Since the move this blanket has been stored in the attic.

notes: Card: 'quickly became the best', 'my new replacement', 'now our number one', 'their favorite'; + pole promotes favorite/indispensable/essential. Probe: 'quickly became my favorite' 1.54, 'now our go-to' 0.60, neutral review 0.29.
